title.narrative: Assam Power Sector Enhancement Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Tranche 1 of the Assam Power Sector Enhancement Investment Program amounting to $49.6 million aims to fund a transmission system infrastructure improvement project in the state of Assam, India. It covers part of the state's power sector road map for enhancing the transmission capacities to improve operational efficiency and electricity service to end users. Tranche 1 will finance: (i) construction of 220 kV and 132 kV power transmission lines; (ii) construction of one 220/132 kV substation and five 132/33 kV substations; and (iii) extension and augmentation of two existing substations.

description.narrative: Enhanced transmission capacity and quality with physical and institutional capacity development.

System losses reduced from 6% transmission in 2008 to 4% transmission in 2014 (Among the targeted 2% reduction, 0.08% will be attributed to the tranche 1 investment) Progress/Status: System losses reduced to 4%. Actual progress will be measured at PCR. Data Source: Tariff orders of AERC Actual value:

Increase in transmission system active power carrying capacity from 766 MW in 2008 to 1,883 MW in 2014 (Among the targeted 1,117MW increase, 513 MW will be attributed to the tranche 1 investment) Progress/Status: About 1,800 MW power carrying capacity achieved. Loan closed in March 2018. Actual progress will be measured at PCR. Data Source: Annual reports of AEGCL Actual value:

Transmission transformation capacity of 6 transmission substations enhanced to reduce transformer loading to less than 80% from the current 95% Progress/Status: Transformer loading is decreased to 80%. Loan closed in March 2018. Actual progress will be measured at PCR. Data Source: Load-flow studies conducted by third parties Actual value:
